report:
Reviewed the complete diagnostic_locations claim, all three ordinary implementation entries (sage-ir diagnostic.rs and harness observe.rs/rustc.rs), and all eight ordinary associated tests. No TODO or N/A evidence is present. Captured additional marker/parser definitions, logical path normalization, macro invocation provenance structure, and review policy with review read.

Implementation: SourceLocation::lines counts preceding newlines and uses end-1 for nonempty half-open spans, but start for empty spans. This supplies interior insertion points, exact line starts, and EOF both with and without trailing newlines. observe::match_compiler_diagnostics compares structured severity, logical path, and inclusive line membership over primary locations only. Its assignment vector is indexed by diagnostic, so ancestry or multiline eligibility cannot multiply events; unmatched diagnostics, including locationless source events, fail. It never reads rendered text for matching. Sage Diagnostic::snapshot starts from Diagnostic::span, resolves source provenance through BangMacro invocation spans or derive source items until reaching a source file, and keeps labels and recursively attached notes separate. DiagnosticSnapshot::render preserves labels and notes, while the matcher ignores them regardless of label style. Macro invocation structures retain their source-bearing AbsoluteSpan and parse generated output under ParseSource::BangMacro. rustc::parse creates one event per top-level JSON error/warning, accepts every is_primary span and recursively follows invocation spans, ignores child and secondary spans, and does not deduplicate messages. is_summary filters only spanless, codeless count-summary shapes; failure-note output is skipped. Other spanless errors/warnings remain events and fail assignment. Logical-path normalization is a shared utility; the anchor-specific selection and matching policy reside in the three associated implementation files.

Tests: empty_spans_match_positions_including_eof asserts Sage matching for a line-start insertion and trailing-newline EOF. labels_and_notes_do_not_supply_matching_locations demonstrates that even a primary-styled label on another line cannot match, its attached warning does not demand another marker, and both label text and note rendering survive. invalid_source_reaches_sage supplies a real multiline primary type-mismatch span and an interior-line marker with an exact diagnostic snapshot. macro_generated_errors_match_the_invocation exercises real Sage macro provenance and asserts the invocation-based snapshot. nested_macro_errors_match_invocations_and_multiple_errors_need_multiple_markers exercises recursive real rustc expansion and rejects too few markers for two errors. primary_spans_and_ancestry_match_but_labels_and_children_do_not asserts the exact eligible lines from multiple primaries and ancestry, excludes secondary and child locations, retains identical top-level diagnostics separately, and rejects a spanless source error. Added empty_primary_and_nested_invocation_spans_keep_position_lines directly tests interior insertion, line start, EOF without newline, and empty final line, both as primary and nested invocation spans; it verifies line membership and single-event assignment even with several eligible ancestry entries. Added only_spanless_summaries_and_failure_notes_are_presentation explicitly checks singular/plural warnings and error counts, mixed counts, failure-note filtering, retention/rejection of other spanless errors and warnings, preservation of a located warning with summary-like text, and severity-specific matching. These additions close the initially identified edge-case evidence gaps without changing the claim or production behavior.

Executed: cargo fmt succeeded; cargo test -p sage-test-harness --lib compile:: -- --nocapture passed 30 tests before the two additions; cargo test -p sage-test-harness --lib compile::rustc::tests -- --nocapture passed all 6 tests after additions; cargo build succeeded with existing warnings. Integration test functions were source-inspected, not independently rerun by this reviewer. A fresh review start after the additions captured the current tests and implementation, and its claim/test metadata were re-inspected. Central delegated post-codegen and Sage sanity checks are coordinated by the parent; this report is the anchor-specific implementation/test adequacy assessment, not a claim those separate checks have finished.
